content: Human-labeling session — combat-hold-chokepoint:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a defensive engagement on a 96x40 arena (tightest tier). You are given 4 medium tanks (Defend orders) at the mouth of a two-cell-wide corridor around (43..44, y=19..20) and a Construction Yard far west at (8,20). The corridor is the only opening through an impassable water wall that splits the map at x=45..51. Fourteen enemy light tanks stage in the eastern lobe — from either a north cluster (y=10..14) or a south cluster (y=26..30) depending on seed — and hunt you through the corridor on AttackAnything orders. Score 9 kills, keep at least 3 tanks at the mouth, hold the Construction Yard, within 5400 ticks.
